combo_label: The Office × Taylor Swift × Paddington Bear

entries.clue: Round-the-table gathering that, all present agree, could have been an email
Two slices with marmalade between, kept beneath a hat for emergencies
Career chapters, each given its own act in the stadium tour she ran from 2023
Toothed machine that reduces confidential paperwork to a nest of thin strips
Tub the bear rode down the stairs, on screen, in a flood of his own making
Ballpoint borrowed and never returned, named for its Hungarian inventor
Poetic word for always, and the wintry sister album that followed folklore
Flawed protagonist, and the Midnights single in which she names herself the problem
Celebratory fizz whose problems title one of her most wrenching piano ballads
Hooded blue duffle, bought for a new arrival on a family shopping trip
Wall-pinned schedule of turns, showing which unlucky soul is on washing-up
Long unblinking look, the hard sort Aunt Lucy taught for use on rude adults
